name: Reactive Ward
body:
Reactive Ward (Su) [Mana Well]
Source Mythic Realms pg. 11
As an immediate action, you can expend one use of mythic power to ward against a spell that would require you to make a saving throw. You attempt a Spellcraft check instead of your saving throw, with a natural 1 automatically failing and a natural 20 automatically succeeding as normal for saving throws. If you succeed at this check against a spell that has a reduced effect with a successful saving throw, it has no effect on you instead. You must choose to use this ability before rolling the saving throw, and you must be capable of using either verbal or somatic components to enact the ward.
